atlasDraft.pZh:
摆停在最低处。阿汐没有去看海，指尖的灰也没有落。门槛边的盐仍在，薄簿仍合着。她添了一根柴，灶火跳了一下。摆没有动，阿汐也没有问它何时会动。

潮水退去，干痕仍在。她没有把这件事记进薄簿。天亮后，灰还留在指尖旁。她没有擦，也没有洗手。

有些停下，不必交给下一个人。
atlasDraft.pEn:
The pendulum rested at its lowest point. Axi did not look toward the sea, and the ash on her fingertip did not fall. The salt remained by the threshold; the thin ledger stayed shut. She fed one stick into the stove. The flame leapt once. The pendulum did not move, and Axi did not ask when it would.

At ebb, the dry mark remained. She did not enter it in the thin ledger. By morning, the ash still rested beside her fingertip. She neither wiped it away nor washed her hand.

Some things may stop without being handed on.
atlasDraft.codaZh: 有些纸，不必翻开，也能留在原处。
atlasDraft.codaEn: Some paper can remain without being opened.
